topic: Effects of Changes in Abiotic Factors on Ecosystems
key_concepts: Ecosystems contain biotic (living) and abiotic (non-living) components.
Abiotic factors include air, water, sunlight, soil, and temperature.
The atmosphere provides oxygen and protects organisms from harmful solar rays.
